description: Bank financial metrics extraction specification for quantitative research. Metrics are organized into categories following CAMELS + DuPont frameworks. Each metric has a controlled name, expected type, and extraction hints. Missing values are handled gracefully via the 'required' flag and the 'error' branch in extraction output.

profitability.label: Profitability & Income
profitability.description: Core income generation, margin, and return metrics. Decomposes ROE via DuPont analysis.

asset_quality.label: Asset Quality & Credit Risk
asset_quality.description: Loan quality, impairment, and credit risk indicators.

capital_adequacy.label: Capital Adequacy
capital_adequacy.description: Regulatory capital ratios, leverage, and loss-absorption capacity.

liquidity.label: Liquidity & Funding
liquidity.description: Short-term and structural liquidity, funding stability, and deposit structure.

efficiency.label: Efficiency & Operations
efficiency.description: Cost management, operational efficiency, and business scale indicators.

growth.label: Growth & Momentum
growth.description: Year-on-year changes in key balance sheet and income items.

valuation.label: Market Valuation
valuation.description: Price multiples and market-based metrics. Often unavailable in regulatory filings.

balance_sheet_structure.label: Balance Sheet Structure
balance_sheet_structure.description: Absolute scale and composition of assets, liabilities, and equity.

metrics.name: net_profit_margin
metrics.label: Net Profit Margin
metrics.description: Net income (profit attributable to shareholders) divided by total operating income for the reporting period. Bank reports do NOT state this directly — compute attributable profit ÷ total income using figures you can cite. Do NOT confuse with 'net interest margin', which is a different metric.

metrics.name: roe
metrics.label: Return on Equity (RoTE)
keywords: weighted average return on net assets
metrics.description: Return on equity for the reporting period. Bank reports state 'return on tangible equity' (RoTE) or 'annualised weighted average return on net assets'. Report the stated figure when available. Do not confuse with return on risk-weighted assets (RoRWA).

metrics.name: roaa
metrics.label: Return on Average Assets
metrics.description: Return on average assets for the reporting period. Often stated alongside ROE. If not stated, compute as net profit attributable to shareholders ÷ average total assets.

metrics.name: net_interest_margin
metrics.label: Net Interest Margin
metrics.description: Net interest income divided by average interest-earning assets. A core bank profitability driver. Reported directly in the management discussion. Do NOT confuse with net profit margin.

metrics.name: net_interest_spread
metrics.label: Net Interest Spread
metrics.description: Difference between the average yield on interest-earning assets and the average cost of interest-bearing liabilities. Often reported alongside NIM.

metrics.name: net_interest_income
metrics.label: Net Interest Income
metrics.description: Total interest income minus interest expense for the period. Core income driver for traditional banking.

metrics.name: net_fee_income
metrics.label: Net Fee & Commission Income
metrics.description: Net fee and commission income. A key indicator of non-interest revenue diversification.

metrics.name: net_operating_income
metrics.label: Net Operating Income
metrics.description: Total net operating income (net interest income + net non-interest income) for the period.

metrics.name: profit_before_tax
metrics.label: Profit Before Tax
metrics.description: Profit before income tax. Useful for cross-jurisdiction comparison before differing tax rates.

metrics.name: net_profit_attributable
metrics.label: Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders
metrics.description: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the bank (after non-controlling interests). The bottom-line earnings figure.

metrics.name: basic_eps
metrics.label: Basic Earnings Per Share
metrics.description: Basic earnings per share attributable to ordinary shareholders. Report the stated figure.

metrics.name: pre_provision_operating_profit
metrics.label: Pre-Provision Operating Profit
metrics.description: Operating profit before impairment losses and taxation. Compute as operating income minus operating expenses. A key measure of underlying profitability before credit costs.

metrics.name: npl_ratio
metrics.label: Non-Performing Loan Ratio
metrics.description: Non-performing loans divided by total loans and advances. The primary headline asset quality metric.

metrics.name: npl_balance
metrics.label: Non-Performing Loan Balance
metrics.description: Absolute balance of non-performing loans. Complements the NPL ratio for understanding scale.

metrics.name: allowance_coverage_ratio
metrics.label: Allowance Coverage Ratio
metrics.description: Total loan loss allowances divided by non-performing loans. Measures the buffer against credit losses. Higher is more conservative.

metrics.name: allowance_to_loan_ratio
metrics.label: Allowance-to-Loan Ratio
metrics.description: Total loan loss allowances divided by total loans. Measures overall provisioning level regardless of NPL classification.

metrics.name: credit_cost_ratio
metrics.label: Credit Cost Ratio
metrics.description: Expected credit losses (or loan impairment charges) divided by average loans, annualised. Measures the flow cost of credit risk.

metrics.name: npl_formation_ratio
metrics.label: NPL Formation Ratio
metrics.description: Newly formed non-performing loans during the period, annualised, divided by total loans. A forward-looking indicator of credit migration.

metrics.name: special_mentioned_loan_ratio
metrics.label: Special-Mentioned Loan Ratio
metrics.description: Special-mentioned (watch-list) loans divided by total loans. An early-warning indicator — loans that may migrate to NPL.

metrics.name: overdue_loan_ratio
metrics.label: Overdue Loan Ratio
metrics.description: Overdue loans (past due but not yet classified as NPL) divided by total loans. A leading indicator of future NPLs.

metrics.name: cet1_ratio
metrics.label: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
metrics.description: Common Equity Tier 1 capital divided by risk-weighted assets. The highest-quality regulatory capital ratio. Report the Advanced/IRB approach figure when available, otherwise the Standardised/Weighted approach.

metrics.name: tier1_ratio
metrics.label: Tier 1 Capital Ratio
metrics.description: Tier 1 capital (CET1 + Additional Tier 1) divided by risk-weighted assets.

metrics.name: total_car
metrics.label: Total Capital Adequacy Ratio
metrics.description: Total regulatory capital (Tier 1 + Tier 2) divided by risk-weighted assets. The broadest capital adequacy measure.

metrics.name: leverage_ratio
metrics.label: Leverage Ratio
metrics.description: Tier 1 capital divided by total exposure (on- and off-balance sheet, unweighted). A non-risk-based backstop to risk-weighted capital ratios. Do NOT confuse with the equity multiplier (assets ÷ equity).

metrics.name: equity_to_assets
metrics.label: Equity-to-Assets Ratio
metrics.description: Total equity divided by total assets. Simple leverage measure. Compute as total equity ÷ total assets.

metrics.name: equity_multiplier
metrics.label: Equity Multiplier
metrics.description: Total assets divided by total shareholders' equity. A measure of leverage. IMPORTANT: do NOT return the regulatory 'leverage ratio' (Tier 1 capital ÷ exposure) — that is a different concept. Compute total assets ÷ total equity.

metrics.name: lcr
metrics.label: Liquidity Coverage Ratio
metrics.description: Stock of high-quality liquid assets divided by net cash outflows over a 30-day stress period. Regulatory minimum typically 100%.

metrics.name: nsfr
metrics.label: Net Stable Funding Ratio
metrics.description: Available stable funding divided by required stable funding over a one-year horizon. Measures structural funding stability.

metrics.name: loan_to_deposit_ratio
metrics.label: Loan-to-Deposit Ratio
metrics.description: Total loans and advances to customers divided by total deposits from customers. A traditional liquidity measure. Compute as loans ÷ deposits.

metrics.name: deposit_to_liability_ratio
metrics.label: Deposit-to-Liability Ratio
metrics.description: Customer deposits divided by total liabilities. Measures reliance on stable deposit funding versus wholesale funding. Compute as deposits ÷ total liabilities.

metrics.name: demand_deposit_ratio
metrics.label: Demand Deposit Ratio
metrics.description: Demand (current/savings) deposits divided by total deposits. Higher CASA ratio indicates cheaper, stickier funding. Report the stated figure when available.

metrics.name: cost_to_income_ratio
metrics.label: Cost-to-Income Ratio
metrics.description: Operating expenses divided by operating income. The primary bank efficiency metric. Lower is better. Report the stated figure.

metrics.name: operating_expenses
metrics.label: Operating Expenses
metrics.description: Total operating expenses (staff costs + other operating expenses) for the period.

metrics.name: asset_turnover
metrics.label: Asset Turnover
metrics.description: Total operating income divided by total assets. Bank reports do NOT state this directly — compute total income ÷ total assets. For sub-annual periods, note whether the figure is annualised.

metrics.name: yield_on_earning_assets
metrics.label: Yield on Earning Assets
metrics.description: Average yield on interest-earning assets (loans, investments, interbank). Often reported in the NIM decomposition table. Report the total yield.

metrics.name: cost_of_funding
metrics.label: Cost of Funding
metrics.description: Average cost of interest-bearing liabilities (deposits, wholesale funding, debt). Often reported in the NIM decomposition table. Report the total cost.

metrics.name: loan_growth_yoy
metrics.label: Loan Growth (YoY)
metrics.description: Year-on-year growth rate of total loans and advances. If not directly stated, compute from current and prior-year loan balances.

metrics.name: deposit_growth_yoy
metrics.label: Deposit Growth (YoY)
metrics.description: Year-on-year growth rate of total customer deposits. If not directly stated, compute from current and prior-year deposit balances.

metrics.name: net_profit_growth_yoy
metrics.label: Net Profit Growth (YoY)
metrics.description: Year-on-year growth rate of net profit attributable to shareholders. Report the stated figure when available.

metrics.name: revenue_growth_yoy
metrics.label: Revenue Growth (YoY)
metrics.description: Year-on-year growth rate of net operating income. Report the stated figure when available.

metrics.name: pe
metrics.label: Price-to-Earnings Ratio
metrics.description: Market price per share divided by earnings per share. The report states EPS but not the market price — return an error if the ratio is not stated in the report.

metrics.name: pb
metrics.label: Price-to-Book Ratio
keywords: tangible net asset value per share
metrics.description: Market price per share divided by book value per share (net assets per share or TNAV per share) at period end. The report may state the book-value component but not the market price — return an error if the ratio is not stated.

metrics.name: dividend_per_share
metrics.label: Dividend Per Share
metrics.description: Total dividend per share declared/proposed for the period. Often only available in annual reports. Return the stated figure.

metrics.name: dividend_payout_ratio
metrics.label: Dividend Payout Ratio
metrics.description: Total dividends divided by net profit attributable to shareholders. Report the stated figure when available, otherwise compute DPS ÷ EPS.

metrics.name: net_assets_per_share
metrics.label: Net Assets Per Share
metrics.description: Equity attributable to ordinary shareholders divided by number of ordinary shares. The denominator for P/B. Report the stated figure.

metrics.name: total_assets
metrics.label: Total Assets
metrics.description: Total assets as reported on the balance sheet at period end.

metrics.name: total_loans
metrics.label: Total Loans & Advances
metrics.description: Total loans and advances to customers (gross of allowances) at period end. Use the Group figure when available.

metrics.name: total_deposits
metrics.label: Total Deposits from Customers
metrics.description: Total deposits from customers at period end. Use the Group figure when available.

metrics.name: total_equity
metrics.label: Total Equity
metrics.description: Total equity (including non-controlling interests) at period end.

metrics.name: total_liabilities
metrics.label: Total Liabilities
metrics.description: Total liabilities at period end.

metrics.name: loan_to_asset_ratio
metrics.label: Loan-to-Asset Ratio
metrics.description: Total loans and advances divided by total assets. Measures the proportion of assets deployed as loans. Compute as loans ÷ total assets.

metrics.name: retail_loan_ratio
metrics.label: Retail Loan Ratio
metrics.description: Retail (personal) loans divided by total loans. Measures the retail vs. corporate loan mix.

metrics.name: financial_investments
metrics.label: Financial Investments
metrics.description: Total financial investments (FVTPL + FVOCI + amortised cost) at period end. Sum across all investment categories.

metrics.name: rwa
metrics.label: Risk-Weighted Assets
metrics.description: Total risk-weighted assets. Can be derived from CET1 capital ÷ CET1 ratio. Report the stated figure when available.

metrics.name: rwa_density
metrics.label: RWA Density
metrics.description: Risk-weighted assets divided by total assets. Measures the average risk weight of the bank's asset portfolio. Compute as RWA ÷ total assets.
